semantic.intent: router.py's module docstring is this tool's only documentation AND its --help description, so it is output rather than a comment. It listed five subcommands while the parser registered eleven commands, and it prescribed the token fingerprint format that fingerprint() deliberately abandoned on 2026-09-14 for leaking -- instructing the next maintainer to undo a safety fix. Make the documented surface match the executable surface in both directions, make the HR-6 wording describe what is actually enforced, and gate both so neither can rot again. This goal is also the Goal Spine's TRANSFER measurement: it must converge with zero changes to the engine.
acceptance: every command the parser registers is named in the docstring, and every command the docstring names is registered
the HR-6 section describes the redaction the code performs, proven by calling fingerprint() rather than by reading prose
HR-6 is measured, not asserted: no real secret appears in the real tool's output
the Goal Spine engine is at the commit recorded before this goal was declared
constraints: read-only against the Owner's credentials: list-accounts only, no API call that spends quota or sends mail
no change to the engine; an engine change is a finding about v1's generality, not a chore
